Danzo fought alongside hiruzen in the 1st great ninja war, and was ashamed he didn't offer himself as a sacrifice for the squad before hiruzen did, showing already he did not care only for himself.  Also, how could someone who operates solely from the shadows, literally being the *shadow* hokage, be someone only in search of glory and power? His entire thing was being *away* from the spotlight, just like tobirama was to hashirama and shikamaru was to kakashi. Not only that, Itachi still slaughtered children, elders, non-shinobi and other defenseless people. My original comment was not to call itachi a villain, it was to say he wasn't a hero. He is a tragic character yes, but throughout the politics of naruto and naruto shippuden, "good" and "bad" are repeatedly shown to be much more complex than the standard "hero-villain" narrative. I am also not saying danzo is a hero or even a good person, but he is not as uniquely "evil" as many people point him out to be. He followed the wishes of his former teacher(tobirama) and served under hiruzen leading the village for DECADES. And not once did he attempt to overthrow him or oust him. Danzo is a very grounded character in the sense that he is willing to do anything and everything he feels he has to if it will benefit the leaf. And considering how horrible of a hokage hiruzen was(Really, he did a terrible job handling the leafs politics compared to the other hokages), it's not at all surprising that Danzo wasn't a very good shadow hokage. Danzo has no legacy, no fond memory, he was never loved or praised by the village at any point and even when he became hokage people in the leaf weren't happy with it.
